split_strategies.proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_1_s: Introduce the binders; if running were zero, substitution and computation would contradict PreH3, unsigned_last_nbits running 32 <> 0.

split_strategies.proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_2_s: Derive running <> 0 by substituting running = 0 into PreH3 and computing unsigned_last_nbits 0 32.

split_strategies.proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_3_s: Derive running <> 0 by contradiction from PreH3 after substituting zero; the class > 16 branch adds no required premise.

witnesses.name: proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_4
witnesses.strategy: Choose the second RHS disjunct, whose grant-right mask equality is PreH1. Derive running <> 0 from PreH2 by substituting zero. Discharge dest/current-space/class facts from the existing premises and cancel the seven unchanged heap cells.

witnesses.name: proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_5
witnesses.strategy: Choose the second RHS disjunct for the zero grant-right mask. Use PreH2 to derive running <> 0, PreH22/PreH23 for class <= 16 and target <> 0, and preserve all eleven cells including the destination slot's old_type, old_content and old_right.

witnesses.name: proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_6
witnesses.strategy: Choose the second RHS disjunct using PreH1. Derive running <> 0 from PreH2; use class <= 16 and target = 0 from PreH22/PreH23. Cancel the eight identical heap resources including the destination table cell.

witnesses.name: proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_7_callee_null
witnesses.strategy: Keep the OSRunning UChar cell while extracting its value range 0 <= running <= 255. This bounds running below 2^32, so unsigned_last_nbits running 32 = running; PreH3 gives running = 0. Choose the second RHS disjunct, rewrite target = 0, and reorder/cancel the destination-table cell and seven global/frame cells.

witnesses.name: proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_8_callee_invalid
witnesses.strategy: Extract running's unsigned-byte range from its owned OSRunning cell without consuming it. Reduce its 32-bit truncation to running, obtaining running = 0 from PreH3. Choose the fourth RHS disjunct, use PreH23 for class > 16, and cancel all seven unchanged cells; no target = 0 premise is needed.

witnesses.name: proof_of_grant_cspace_cap_return_wit_11_callee_success
witnesses.strategy: Use the owned OSRunning UChar resource to obtain 0 <= running <= 255, identify unsigned_last_nbits running 32 with running, and infer running = 0 from PreH4. Select the second RHS disjunct. PreH24/PreH25 discharge class <= 16 and target <> 0. Reorder and cancel all eleven cells, preserving the callee's already-produced values 1, class, and Z.lor (Z.land old_right 4095) right exactly; the transition premise requires no extra bitwise theorem.
